official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Hoosha lets you create images, video, music and speech from a conversation, using the models and credits of your existing Hoosha account.

How a request works: say what you want in your own words. Hoosha asks only what changes the result, suggests one model with a short reason, and shows a review of what it will make, the settings, the files and the exact credit cost. Nothing is generated until you say so, and one go-ahead means one generation. Prompt help, ideas, model comparisons and price questions are answered as text and spend nothing.

What you can do:
- Create an image from a description, or edit and combine images you attach.
- Create a video from text or images, including lip-sync and motion transfer.
- Create a song or an instrumental track from a description or your own lyrics (two tracks per request).
- Turn text into speech with one voice or as a dialogue between several voices.
- See the available models with their options and credit costs, check your credit balance, and look up earlier generations.

After you confirm, the amount charged is shown at once and the Hoosha card follows the generation until the result appears in the conversation. Results are also saved in your Hoosha account. Images usually take under two minutes; video and music can take several minutes.

Limitations: a Hoosha account with credits is required. Credits cannot be bought or topped up through the plugin, and generations cannot be cancelled or deleted from here. Reference videos are limited to 30 seconds and reference audio to between 2 and 30 seconds.
